# Pimsleur

> Audio-based language learning platform featuring Dr. Paul Pimsleur's scientifically-proven Method for conversational fluency through mobile apps and lifetime subscriptions.

Pimsleur offers courses in 50+ languages including Spanish, Hindi, Hebrew, Polish, Swiss German, and Brazilian Portuguese. The platform integrates with CarPlay, Android Auto, and Amazon Alexa, featuring interactive tools like Voice Coach, Speak Easy, Quick Match Quiz, and Speed Round for self-paced audio learning.
